subject.title: doctor: false positive cleanup hint for active gateway LaunchAgent plist

question: Should maintainers repair and land the open linked PR as the fix for this issue, or replace it with a narrower cleanup-hint PR that preserves current SecretRef safety behavior?
rationale: This issue has an open closing PR that covers the requested work but remains proof/risk-gated; ClawSweeper should not queue a duplicate fix while that candidate is active.

options.title: Repair linked PR first
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52515, require real macOS/SecretRef proof, and land it only if cleanup hints become service-specific or safely suppressed without weakening exec SecretRef defaults.

options.title: Replace with narrower PR
options.body: If the linked branch is not salvageable, close or supersede it after opening a focused fix for the cleanup-hint target while keeping current SecretRef behavior intact.

options.title: Leave issue waiting
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation if maintainers want to defer the doctor/status cleanup-hint behavior to a broader gateway-service UX pass.
